claude.rationale: This was a whole-company cash merger in which AMRI survived intact as a wholly-owned subsidiary of a Carlyle/GTCR acquisition vehicle; the entire integrated contract-research/manufacturing business (product/asset tier, T4) transferred together with its operating footprint and processes (T5) in a single going-concern entity, so no product-vs-process mismatch exists at closing (gap_45=0). AMRI's pre-existing officer group was expressly retained in place immediately after closing, with 12-month compensation/benefit continuity commitments and honored severance—so the people/organization running operations (T6) transferred coherently alongside the processes (gap_56=0). T1 is replace because the controlling principal shifted from public shareholders to the new sponsor-owned Parent (board resigned and was replaced by Merger Sub designees), and T3 is swap because AMRI's charter/bylaws were amended and restated into Merger Sub's form and its Delaware vehicle became a private subsidiary delisted from Nasdaq.
